notes.title: Progress Blog #22 – Alpha Update in Final Testing
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The Alpha Update, originally planned for release last week, is still in its final internal testing phase. During the latest test runs, we identified a few remaining technical aspects that we want to optimize before releasing the update.

What’s happening right now?
We’re working on targeted fine-tuning to further improve stability, performance, and overall user experience. Our goal is to deliver a solid version that runs reliably across different systems.

What’s next?
As soon as the current adjustments are complete and meet our quality standards, the update will be made available on the open Alpha branch.

How can you support us?
If you'd like to support the project, you can add the game to your wishlist and follow us to stay up to date. This not only helps with visibility but also shows your interest in the ongoing development.

Thank you
We truly appreciate your patience, your feedback, and your support.

Your MS Games and Software Team

notes.title: Progress Blog #21 – Memory Optimization Completed & Alpha Update Incoming
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We'd like to give you a quick but important update on the current status.  
After an intensive week of targeted optimization work, we've successfully addressed the memory issues that were discussed in the last blog post.

Technical Optimizations Showing Results
Over the past few days, we've made several adjustments to assets and textures, removed unnecessary data, and improved compression.  
These measures have led to significantly reduced memory usage and more stable performance in our internal tests on various systems.

Next Step: Alpha Update
Based on the current results, we plan to release the update for the Open Alpha branch next week – assuming the final tests continue to go as expected.  
Our focus remains on delivering a stable and high-quality version.

Thank You for Your Patience
We know many of you are eagerly awaiting the update. Your feedback, support, and patience mean a lot to us and are a key part of our development process.

See you soon,
Your MS Games and Software Team

notes.title: Progress Blog #19: We're working on the next Alpha update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We would like to update you on the current status of our work in the open Alpha branch. Based on your valuable feedback, we have been working intensively on several aspects, and now we are preparing a new update – although it has not been released yet!
What has been achieved?

 New Objects & Bugfixes:
We have planned new objects and are currently addressing some bugs. In particular, since today we have been analyzing isolated crashes in the tutorial and the main menu. Once these issues are resolved, we can release the update.
 Expanded Tutorial:
The tutorial, which is essential for getting started with our game, will be expanded in the upcoming update. Our goal is to provide new players with an even better and smoother start.
 General Improvements:
Thanks to your feedback, we were able to identify and resolve several issues. With small, steady steps, we are getting closer to the major update for version 0.9.0.

What’s next?
Our current build in the open Alpha branch will continue to be tested. Based on the results and your feedback, we will implement the next features. As soon as we are confident that the new version runs stably and meets our quality standards, we will inform you immediately.

Please note: This update is still in the development phase and is currently being tested internally only. As soon as we are satisfied with the results, we will let you know right away.

Thank you for your patience and your ongoing feedback – together we are getting ever closer to the final update!

Your development team

notes.title: Progress Blog #11: Latest version for PC and PS5
notes.notes:
Hello dear Ghost Hunter community,

We are happy to share with you today the latest developments for the PC and PS5 versions of "The Ghost - Task of the Ghost Hunters". Today a new test version went live for internal testing, which includes some exciting new features!
New Features:
[olist]
Retro PC Integration: In addition to the features mentioned in the last progress blog, we have added an old retro PC that integrates multiple systems:

New Shop: In the shop you can buy various items that are available. Purchasing an item depends on two factors: you must have reached the corresponding level and have enough money.
Job Offers: New jobs can be accepted via the Retro PC. The available job offers depend on various factors. In multiplayer mode, more job offers are available to you, and the more players there are, the more job offers are offered. Some jobs require a certain number of players to complete the level.
Equipment management: Here you can select the equipment you want to take with you on the next mission.
Player system: You can see and manage all players for future COOP missions.

[/olist]
Improvements and bug fixes:
We continue to do everything we can to improve the gaming experience and fix existing bugs. The performance optimizations and fingerprint features from the last update are also included in this new test version and have been further refined.

We are excited to hear your feedback on these new features and hope that you are as excited as we are. Share your experiences and suggestions with us so that we can continuously improve the game.

Sincerely,
The Ghost - Task of the Ghost Hunters development team

P.S. Add "The Ghost - Task of the Ghost Hunters" to your wishlist now on the PlayStation Store!

notes.title: Update-Blog #1
notes.notes:
Dear developer community,

It's time for exciting news again! We're excited to announce that a brand new update to our Open Alpha Branch will be released tomorrow evening at 7:00 PM CEST. This update brings a host of exciting changes and improvements that will take the gaming experience to a whole new level. Let's take a look at what to expect:

New objects:

We listened to your wishes and implemented a variety of new objects into the game. These objects open up new ways for you to explore the game world and promote your strategic thinking. From different types of barriers to functional elements, these new objects expand your tactical possibilities and offer exciting new ways to overcome your challenges.

Stationary base:

One of the biggest changes in this update is the introduction of the stationary base. This robust structure serves as a central hub for your operations and offers a variety of resource management and planning features. Use it as a strategic retreat or as a headquarters for your expeditions - the possibilities are endless.

New textures:

To further deepen the immersion in our game worlds, we introduced new textures that bring every detail to life. From the picturesque landscape to the smallest details, the new textures provide a breathtaking visual experience and immerse you even deeper in the world.

Optimization of lighting effects:

Light plays a crucial role in the atmosphere of a game, and that's why we worked hard to optimize the lighting effects. Experience more realistic lighting scenarios that perfectly capture the mood of each scene and take your gaming experience to a new level.

Performance improvements:

We know how important a smooth gaming experience is, and that's why we also focused on game performance. The new update includes a variety of improvements designed to increase the overall performance of the game. Enjoy a smoother and more immersive experience as you explore the new content.

New dialogs in the tutorial:

We've also revised the tutorial and added new dialogue to help you get started with the game and give you an even more comprehensive introduction to the world.

In order to inform you about the actual changes in detail, we have put together a changelog that will be published together with the update. There you can see and read about all the innovations at a glance. We'll also summarize the most important changes to make sure you're well informed.

We can't wait to see how you use these new features and improvements in your games. Your feedback is particularly important to us, so don't hesitate to share your thoughts and suggestions with us!

The update will be released tomorrow evening at 7:00 p.m. CEST. So be ready to update your game and explore the new content. We look forward to creating an even more fascinating game world together with you!

Thank you for your support and commitment!

Best regards,
The development team of The Ghost - Task of the Ghost Hunters

notes.title: Version 0.8.0.
notes.notes:
Version 0.8.0 marks a significant milestone for The Ghost - Task of the Ghost Hunters as the game remains in Early Access. With a wealth of new features, improvements and adjustments, we strive to deepen the gaming experience and respond to feedback from our community. This version not only brings a playable character with basic animations, but also a variety of new ways for players to move around and interact with the game world. Important optimizations have also been made to make the gameplay even more appealing. We warmly invite our players to participate in the open Alpha Branch and give us their valuable feedback to advance the development of The Ghost - Task of the Ghost Hunters together.

New features:

First playable character:

Players can now control the first playable character, equipped with important basic animations for movement, interactions and reactions.

New keyboard shortcuts:

A variety of new key combinations have been added, including the ability to run while holding the left shift key to increase the player's speed.

First-person/third-person switching:

By pressing the "C" key, players can seamlessly switch between first-person and third-person views to customize their preferred perspective.

New input interface:

A completely redesigned keyboard input interface has been implemented to provide more precise and user-friendly control.

Ghost ID:

The Ghost Pass was introduced to give players an overview of their progress and achievements.

German text edition:

The text output has now been localized in German to offer German players a more immersive gaming experience.

Adjustable volume:

Players now have the ability to adjust the overall volume of the game through the options to customize their listening experience.

Mouse sensitivity settings:

Mouse sensitivity can now also be adjusted in the game settings to allow for more precise mouse control.

New objects:

A selection of new objects have been introduced into the game world to enrich the environment and diversify gameplay.

New animations:

New animations have been added, including animations for doors, cabinets and other interactions, to increase the immersion and dynamism of the game.

Changes:

Optimizations of existing objects:

Existing objects have been reworked and optimized to provide performance improvements and fix potential bugs.

Visual improvements:

Textures have been reworked to create a more visually appealing gaming environment and improve the overall experience.

Revised day and night cycle:

The day and night cycle has been fundamentally redesigned, including an updated in-game time and the introduction of a custom date.

Exchanging sound files:

Some sound files have been replaced to improve the sound quality and immersion experience.

We warmly invite you to participate in our open Alpha Branch and give us your valuable feedback. Please note that the game is still in early access and is under active development. Your opinion is crucial for the further development and improvement of the game. Thank you for your support!

 Overlapping objects in the police level have been corrected.

 New player controls

 The ghost has received a new AI.

Troubleshooting

 Performance improved

Now that the update is public, let's focus on the games. The core content is the spirit, the economic system and the COOP.
